translations.web: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
translations.bsb: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; call him to account for his wickedness until none is left to be found.
translations.kjv: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.
translations.asv: Break thou the arm of the wicked; And as for the evil man, seek out his wickedness till thou find none.
